messages:
deploybot: created tag `release-2026-03-20-1` from commit 8f3c2a7 (refs/heads/main) and attached changelog summary. will start canary in us-west in 10m. link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/8f3c2a7

celeste: thanks — dropping the changelog snippet here for visibility. main user-facing changes: 
- optimize serving runtime kernel selector (less cold-start overhead)
- batching heuristics tweak to reduce median latency for short prompts
- fixed rare KV cache eviction bug causing inconsistent completions

omar: any special pin instructions for dedicated tenants?

deploybot: pinned image digest: `sha256:fa12b9...` — for Dedicated customers you should pin `release-2026-03-20-1` or the digest above. see deploy playbook for pin steps.

kai: starting canary in us-west (2 machines, 5% traffic) -> canary window 30m. will escalate to 25% then 100% if metrics stable. holding APAC until us and eu finish due to region-specific quantized kernels.

celeste: @kai please note: do not advance if error-rate >0.3% or p95 latency increases >200ms vs baseline. update thread with metric snapshots at 10/20/30m.

oncall-bot: scheduled canary window (30m) for `release-2026-03-20-1` in us-west. alerts will go to #eng-oncall.

release-eng: quick rollback plan in case: 
1) pause traffic routing to tag `release-2026-03-20-1` via router canary flag
2) rollback to `release-2026-03-19-4` (previous stable) using image digest `sha256:9b88ee...`
3) run smoke tests for 5 min, then reopen traffic

omar: tagging ops note for Dedicated: after pinning, run config apply: 
```
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant=acme --model=main --tag=release-2026-03-20-1 --digest=sha256:fa12b9...
```

kai: canary metrics 10m: error-rate 0.08% (ok), p95 +30ms (ok). moving to 25% traffic in 5m.

celeste: thanks. heading to update release notes page and internal deploy doc. tagging @release-eng to confirm rollback criteria is good. :white_check_mark:

release-eng: criteria agreed. also note a temporary region hold for APAC until kernel quantization validation completes (expected +6h). annotate release notes and inform partners.

omar: will send pin checklist to sales/solutions for Dedicated customers.

deploybot: canary advanced to 25%. will report again at 25/50/100% milestones.

kai: FYI if we see increased hallucination regressions in eval set, we hold and revert. eval-run id: eval-2026-03-20-17.

celeste: added changelog link in release doc: https://docs.internal/releases/release-2026-03-20-1

oncall-bot: canary complete: advanced to 100% in us-west and eu-west, APAC still on hold. metrics stable. marking thread resolved in 1h if no regressions. :tada:
